fields.statement: Plan review round 3 left finding f1 (missing-acceptance on wait-merges-conflicting-pr): Its acceptance (and statement) check that `ship check --conflicts` exits 1 after the resolving merge, but the --conflicts flag is introduced by ship-change-conflict-fix-step, which depends-on wait-merges-conflicting-pr and so is built after it. When this leaf is built and verified the flag does not exist, so that part of its acceptance cannot run. Either move the --conflicts assertion to ship-change-conflict-fix-step's acceptance, or move the flag into this leaf (or ship-rebase-merges-only) and reverse the ordering. The critic confirmed it: internal/api/ship.go ShipCheckRequest has no --conflicts flag today (only settled, main, pr-open, test-failures); ship-change-conflict-fix-step introduces it and depends-on wait-merges-conflicting-pr, so it is built later. wait-merges-conflicting-pr's acceptance asserts 'ship check --conflicts exits 1' after the resolving merge, which cannot run when that leaf is built and verified. How should it be settled?
